turnaround_reason: FOXF was beaten down from $30+ to $13 after a dismal FY2025 that included a massive ~$545M net loss (impairments/write-downs) and margin compression. Management responded with a $50M cost reduction program, non-core divestitures with all proceeds earmarked for debt reduction, and a refocus on core PVG/aftermarket. Q1 2026 beat guidance and FY2026 guidance reaffirms a 200 bps EBITDA margin improvement despite a ~5% revenue decline, with H2 margin expansion expected from cost programs and tariff relief. Stock is recovering off the $13 low to ~$19.64.
bullish_points: Q1 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA exceeded guidance, driven by PVG and aftermarket strength
Previous EPS beat: Q1 2026 reported $0.18 vs $0.08 estimate (+119.51% surprise)
FY2026 guidance reaffirms 200 bps EBITDA margin expansion with $50M targeted cost savings
Divesting non-core businesses, all proceeds to debt reduction (de-levering story)
EPS recovery trajectory: FY2026E $1.40 (+31.9% YoY) → FY2027E $1.74 (+24.7%)
Reasonable valuation: EV/EBITDA 10.6x, P/B 1.25x, forward PE ~14x
Stock technically recovering: 10% above 200d MA, 112% of 100d MA, +11.9% in 30d
Short interest 11.5% of float with short ratio 5.3 — a positive surprise could squeeze
bearish_points: Revenue still declining: FY2026E $1.40B (-4.5% YoY) — not a growth story yet
High leverage: $787M debt vs $54M cash, D/E 119%, debt to enterprise value ~50%
FY2025 net loss of ~$545M (includes large impairment) — quality of earnings in question
Only 1 insider open-market purchase signal in 6m (only stock grants, no buys)
BofA downgraded to Sell with $20 target (June 2026)
Operating margins thin at 1.6% — little room for error
Near-term catalyst (earnings Aug 6) cuts both ways — a miss could re-break the stock
Options open interest thin (21 calls / 8 puts on sampled expiry) despite 3 expiries
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings report on 2026-08-06 (tomorrow). Need to see cost-savings progress, margin recovery confirmation, and divestiture close timing.
catalyst_timing: 2026-08-06 (tomorrow after close), plus follow-through from divestiture closings through H2 2026
suggested_trade: Wait for earnings print (Aug 6) before initiating. If beat + raised guidance: spot starter with room to add on a pullback to $18-19. Avoid pre-earnings due to binary risk and thin options liquidity. December 2026 calls only if conviction hardens post-print.
key_risk: Earnings miss or soft H2 margin commentary re-breaks the stock below $13 low, especially given high leverage and 11.5% short interest amplifying downside.
would_skip_if: Earnings show margin expansion stalling, divestiture proceeds not flowing to debt, or revenue decline accelerating beyond -6%. Also skip if management withdraws/refuses to reaffirm FY2026 guidance.
